title: desk-operator device definition (device.toml), format v1
description: What's true for every unit of a model. Nothing bench-specific (no providers, entities, bench limits, serial numbers). Spec: docs/definition-format.md. desk itself validates more than this schema can express (`desk library check`).

requires.description: Oldest desk-operator the driver works with, e.g. "desk-operator >= 0.1"

status.description: community: from documentation, not yet run on real hardware. tested: smoke-tested on real hardware (list versions in `tested`).

tested.description: Hardware/firmware versions it was smoke-tested with. Required when status = "tested".

sources.description: Manuals, protocol documentation, community work the definition is based on

power.description: power_switch capability: a Lua driver with on(ctx), off(ctx), optional state(ctx)

source.description: voltage_source capability: a Lua driver with set_voltage, set_current, set_output, read

script.description: Lua driver, relative to this file

port.description: USB ids of the model. Serial numbers and paths are per unit: users add them in their own config.

params.description: Data for the driver, validated against the driver's PARAMS declaration (see `desk library show`)
